‘Deadliest Dinners Australia’ (Trailer)

0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

A co-production between the Foxtel Group and Mew Productions, Binge series Deadliest Dinners follows chef Mario Kalpou as he returns home to tackle some of the planet’s most dangerous terrain and deadliest creatures, chasing down wild ingredients and cooking them on location.

He works alongside local experts, Indigenous custodians, and regional specialists to better understand the ecosystems he enters, with a focus on sustainable harvesting and conservation.

Kalpou executive produces for Mew Productions alongside Howard Myers-Rifai and Chris Hearn for Foxtel Group.

Deadliest Dinners Australia will premiere on Binge at 9am on September 9, 2026. Foxtel customers can also watch at 7:30pm on FOX8.
